title: Generated content
description: Each piece of content the run wrote, in the order the document shows them, so a later step can send, review or reuse a piece without reading the document. Every required field is stated: the value from the work, copied exactly, or null when there is none. Nothing is made up.

pieces.description: One row per piece written. A sequence is one row per step.

step.description: Its place in a sequence, starting at 1; null for a single piece.

recipientName.description: Who it is written to, when it is written to one person.

recipientEmail.description: Only an address the request or a tool gave; never guessed.

companyDomain.description: The recipient's company domain, matching an account row when the request came with a list.

subject.description: The subject line; null for a piece that has none.

body.description: The piece in full, as the document shows it.

angle.description: One sentence on the angle taken and what it rests on.
